justification: Both surfaces bear shallow relief carving that includes horizontal lines of small repeated script-like signs organised in registers, which is the only real correspondence. A shows a fully figural scene — a standing figure with a staff facing a large seated figure raising a bowl, on a throne with footstool — whereas B shows no identifiable figures at all, only dense inscribed text-like bands, so the depicted subject matter is essentially different.
